name: AI Builder OS
purpose: Portable methodology, production crew contracts, standards and eval system for building AI-enabled operational systems without carrying customer-specific data or business secrets.

maturity_model.PROJECT_VERIFIED: Supported by observed project failure/evidence plus later corrective pattern or enforced contract.
maturity_model.CROSS_PROJECT_PENDING: Portable hypothesis with strong project evidence but awaiting independent validation outside EcoFlow.
maturity_model.CROSS_PROJECT_VERIFIED: Requires additional independent project/domain evidence or external authoritative standard plus reproduced eval.
maturity_model.CANDIDATE: Plausible lesson without sufficient incident/evidence chain; must not be promoted silently.

non_goals: Do not turn EcoFlow-specific rules into universal standards.
Do not extract a generic runtime/kernel merely because code can be reused.
Do not treat an AI agent's self-report as completion evidence.
Do not replace deterministic business state with model memory.
